book.name: 2 PEDRO
book.title: 2 PEDRO Pedronen raanni joi, jahuen rabe coti

content: Neayanish ta rabe sca hen mato qui raanai quirica qui, heen huetsabaan. Rabebichin tah hen mato shinanmahi, man shinanquin sirijanon.
Papan joi yohinicabaan huishaquin jayaxihquibo yohini joi shinannahue. Noque teehihmanica noquen Hihbaan raantiboxon non mato yohini joi rihbi shinanquin sirijanahue.
Nea pari honannahue: nete queyoti nea pishca sca jaiya ta hosanmisbo jotihiqui. Tiromati jenipahixon ta mato hosan hosanyaxihcanihqui.
¿Jan joribiyaxihqui jan yohini cahran? Noquen xenibo mahuani tian ta rahma caman jatihibi jascabi jaiqui, Diosen jato jonijani quescapahbo, hih ta jayaxihcanihqui.
Nea hen mato yohixihqui ta honancatsihyamacaniqui. Jahuen join ta Papan naijanishqui, neateman bi res. Jahuen join rihbi maijaquin, jene chicho quehax cainnon, jene naponbi sca mai janon maijaquin.
Jahuen join rihbi ta jene mai mahpomanishqui, jaatian jihuetaibo mahuanon.
Jaa join rihbi ta rahma caman jai naiyahpa mai manamahiqui jato mapojayanoxon. Casticanquin jan nincayosmabo queyobahinyaxihqui neten caman ta naiyahpa mai manamahiqui.
Nea shinanbehnoyamanahue, heen huetsabaan. Huesti nete ta huesti mil bari quesca rihbi qui, Papan jisí. Huesti mil bari rihbi huesti nete quesca.

Jan yohini quescabijaquin ta noquen Hihbaan chiquishbochi bi hahyamahiqui, chiquishbochi bi hahcai caibaan shinanai bi. Matohon shinanih bi ta joriyamahihqui. Tsoabi queyotima bi ta non jatihixonbi noquen shinan ponteti jaa queenihqui.

Yometso sanareneni jahuicamareneni ta histon res jaa joti nete nocoyaxihquiqui. Jaatian ta nai coshin corotax queyocahinyaxihquiqui. Nai naman mehabo rihbi mapohi queyocahini. Jonibaan teeboyabi mai mapohi queyocahini.
¿Jaabo jatihibi queyotihi honanxon man siri jihueti shinanyamahin? ¿Papa shinani jihuetai siribo man jatimahin?
Papan tiromajati nete nocotaiya ta naibo mapojaha queyocahinyaxihquiqui. Maiboya jenebo rihbi mapohi cohincahini. Jaa nete noconon mananahue. Jaa joti manati jihuenahue.
Jan yohini quescabijaquin tah non nai behna sca bihyaxihqui, mai behna rihbi sca bihquin, jano tsoabi tiroma yamascai. Jaa tah non manatai.
Jaa manahahnan sca rishtajoma siripi jihuetaibo jan mato merahi jonon, jascari jihueti hihti shinannahue, hea huetsabaan.
Jahuerohahi ta noquen Hihbo joriyamahiqui, hea hihbohue hah non janon, hihnahue. Hahan non queenai noquen huetsa Pablonen rihbi ta jascajaquin mato qui joi raannishqui, Papan shinan hinanah.

Raannoxon huishaxon tihibi ta jascajaquin jaan yohihiqui. Jan yohihi ta caibo joi histon honantima qui. Shinanjomabaan ta jaa huisha jisxon bi honanyamaxon jaamajaquin yohihiqui. Texe Papan huishamani joibo jascajaribiquin. Jaa copi ta Papan jato queyoyaxihquiqui.
Hen yohihah tah man honanscai, heen huetsabaan. Coiramescanahue, jaamajaquin tiromabaan mato paranah man Cristo joi bihquin bi jenebahin jenebahinmis.
Jascapahxonma bi noquen Hihbaan shinanya hichajabonanahue. Jaa noque teehihmanica Jesucristo hashoan sca honanbonaquin. Jaa ta Nete Hihbo qui hihnahue, rahma, jascabihi sca jascari. Jascari rahan.
